lesson_title: The Secret in the School Cupboard
hook_text: In a dusty cupboard, a Grade 4 class found a book that was written a hundred years ago.
clip_script: Makhanda, Eastern Cape. A school turns one hundred, and the learners open the old cupboard in the office. Inside: a logbook, written by hand by principals since the school began. A register of the first learners. A yellow newspaper cutting. A letter. Outside, a stone above the door with a date carved into it. All of these are written sources. Read them carefully. Ask who wrote it, when and why. Writing lets the past speak to us.
visual_style: Whiteboard cupboard door swinging open, books and papers flying out and landing on a timeline, then a magnifying glass over handwriting.
pacing: Open the cupboard, reveal each written source, then the three questions.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look for writing about the past in your own school or town.
